answer: A jetty lets only one boat dock at a time, and identity should work the same: each agent must prove control of a unique postal address by receiving a mailed one-time code and returning it within days, then re-proving it at random intervals. A crystal-clear paper trail ties every identity to a real place. A sybil cannot fake a pearl of a thousand agents from one mailbox — each fake identity costs a separate real address, mail handling, and a person to open the envelope.
